map.GRP 和 Reach 是一回事吗？: Are GRP and Reach the same thing?
map.不是。GRP（总收视点）= 收视率×频次，衡量总曝光强度；Reach（到达率）是: No. GRP (gross rating points) = rating × frequency measures total exposure intensity, while Reach is the share of people who saw the ad at least once. GRP = Reach × Frequency, so the two should be read together.
